summary: Iteration 12 — Validated super-admin override in foreign rooms, /api/admin/console/give-diamonds, authority endpoint, kick-from-seat, ban-user+join rejection, unban-user, lock-seat/lock-all/unlock-all super override, Firebase Web key configured status. 15/15 backend pytest pass. Frontend: login works, ControlPanel opens via ProfileView→open-admin-panel, RoomView renders for foreign rooms. Confirmed in code that required data-testids (console-give-diamonds, console-set-aristocracy, room-lock-all-btn, room-unlock-all-btn, Super Admin badge) are conditionally rendered for super admin / dueño (RoomView.js L950-958, ControlPanel.js L542/544).

minor.issue: serialize_room does NOT expose banned_users field to clients. Ban is persisted and enforced server-side (join→403 works), but front-end cannot render or manage the banned-user list without this field. Recommend including banned_users (list of user_ids) in serialize_room output.

integration_issues.issue: console-give-diamonds / console-set-aristocracy live inside the 'Consola' sub-tab of the ControlPanel (default open tab is 'Salas'). Automated click of the top 'Centro Control' (header button on Dashboard) actually opens the EventControlPanel modal (flash events, traffic monitor) — NOT the full Console page with give-diamonds. The full Console is only reachable via ProfileView → 'open-admin-panel' testid. Consider adding a direct shortcut from Dashboard for the owner, or document the nav clearly.

action_items: Include banned_users in serialize_room so the frontend can show/manage banned users

(UX nit) Dashboard has TWO different 'Centro Control' entry points — the top-bar 'Centro Control' chip opens only the EventControlPanel modal; the full Console is only inside ProfileView. Unify or rename to avoid confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rooms.py _get_authority: correct and concise. Uses user.is_super_admin OR role=='dueño'. Well-designed authority helper.
routes/rooms.py join_room: banned_users check correctly short-circuits for super admin/dueño. Good.

routes/rooms.py kick/ban: inserts chat system message with username of admin — good UX trail. But chat message uses literal emoji '🛡️' with user-provided username — safe from injection since it's DB text only.

routes/admin.py give-diamonds: does NOT validate target exists; will silently succeed with new_diamonds read from missing doc returning None if target_id invalid (update_one no-ops). Consider 404 check before $inc.
routes/admin.py give-diamonds: no upper bound / audit log. Owner can give unbounded negative amounts — could drive diamonds negative. Consider clamp to max(0, current+amount).
ControlPanel.js: console-give-diamonds and console-set-aristocracy testids present. Confirmed >=6 confirm dialog + >100k confirm per requirements.
RoomView.js L950: super admin visibility gate is (room.owner_id===user.id || user.role==='dueño' || user.is_super_admin) — correct and matches backend _get_authority.
frontend/.env: REACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID now uses ':web:' — verified via /api/auth/firebase/status returning web_api_key_configured=true and project_id=lluvia-live-69a05.

success_rate.frontend: Verified loading of ControlPanel page + RoomView. Full interactive click on Consola sub-tab not executed within token budget, but required data-testids and conditional rendering are present per static code review.
